about: Start dates of Hijri months in Bangladesh, as announced by the National Moon Sighting Committee (Islamic Foundation Bangladesh). The Salat app downloads this file and uses these dates instead of its calculation. After each announcement, add one entry: hijri = year-month (month 01 = Muharram ... 12 = Zilhaj), start = the Gregorian date of the 1st of that month in Bangladesh.

months.note: Zilqad moon not sighted; month begins 20 April
Safar moon sighted; month begins 16 July (BSS on 13 Aug confirms Safar completed 30 days)
Rabiul Awal moon not sighted on 13 Aug; month begins 15 Aug; Eid-e-Miladunnabi 26 Aug
Rabius Sani moon sighted on 12 Sep; Fateha-e-Yazdaham (11th) on 23 Sep
Jamadiul Awal began 13 Oct: BSS on 10 Nov says it completes 30 days on 11 Nov (announcement itself not found)
Jamadi-us-Sani moon not sighted on 10 Nov; month begins Thursday 12 Nov
